    5 out of 5 stars
    Second Yeti Item and I'm obsessed
    I absolutely love this YETI water bottle! The neon yellow color is incredibly vibrant and stands out in the best way it's. I easy to spot whether I'm at the gym, in the office, or outdoors. Performance-wise, it does exactly what you'd expect from YETI. It keeps my water cold for hours, even on hot days, and I often still have ice left long after filling it. The chug cap is one of my favorite features. As the name suggests, it's perfect for taking big sips without spilling. The mouthpiece feels very similar to drinking from a regular plastic water bottle, which makes it comfortable and natural to use. It's a small detail that makes a big difference, especially if you're constantly reaching for your bottle throughout the day. Overall, this is a high-quality, well-designed bottle that's durable, practical, and looks great. If you're considering it, I highly recommend it!

      First of all, the color is beautiful - perhaps not quite as brilliant as in the photos, but it is delightful. This second one I received was a replacement for the first one that was sent, which seemed to have some damage to the interior lining (presumably a manufacturing flaw). This replacement bottle has a seamless and flawless interior lining, for which I am grateful; however, the outside has a slight dent in it. I'm not sure if that is because of packaging/shipping issues or if it was sent out that way. I do know the bottle was sent in a bag, not a box, so it is very possible there was damage done during shipping. I'm a bit disappointed, but not to the point of returning this one. Still, I think from now on, I will order any YETI item directly from YETI since it will hopefully be packaged better for shipping. As for the product itself, it is a nice size, the handle makes it easy to carry, and I like the chug cap very much. It also does a great job in keeping my water cold even when I left it in a hot car for a few hours. Overall, a great product but sad that I received it already dented.

    About this Item

    • Get to drinking faster with the Leakproof Chug Cap. It just takes a quick half-twist of the TripleHaul Handle to open and then you’re good to go, making it easy to steal a sip without slowing down

    Product Description

    Rambler 36 BottleYETI Coolers were designed for all sorts of great outdoor adventures, and there’s even a YETI for all the times in between. The YETI Rambler Series is perfect for the ride to the deer lease, time spent at the cleaning table, or just sitting around the campfire trying to one-up each other’s stories. With double-wall vacuum insulation, these over-engineered drink holders keep your favorite beverage as cold — or hot — as science allows. They’re breakthroughs on another front, too — they’re the first YETIs you can fit in the palm of your hand.18/8 Stainless Steel Made with kitchen-grade stainless steel, so they’re puncture- and rust-resistant. TripleHaul Cap Three finger grip for easy carrying and 100% leakproof.No Sweat Design Keeps fingers dry and un-frostbit.Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation Keeps cold drinks cold and hot drinks hot until the last sip.The Rambler family is now sporting DuraCoat Color, the durable new look available for your Tumbler, Colster, or Bottle. YETI DuraCoat Color is available in four different shades: Seafoam, Tahoe Blue, Black, and Olive Green. It's designed to go on strong, and we think it's pretty good looking to boot, making it perfect for our stainless steel drinking vessels. It won't fade, peel, or crack through extended field use, and our DuraCoat Color provides additional grip to the Rambler's exterior. So whether you have your sights set on a Seafoam 20 oz. Tumbler or a Tahoe Blue Colster, our DuraCoat Color will hold up through the life of your warranty.
